evidence.bug_identified: Mathematical error in SQLite query where col.crt was added instead of calculating (now_ts - crt) / 86400, causing all 6932 review cards to be marked due.
evidence.fix_applied: Calculated today_days from (now_ts - crt) // 86400 and queried c.queue IN (2, 3) AND c.due <= today_days.

evidence.explanation: Grammar points were locked under the Vocab-First (i+1 Comprehensible Input) gate because required vocabulary words were not yet reviewed.
bug_fixes: Fixed ruby furigana stripping in grammar_vocab_gate.py and sentence_gate.py so words like 確認 are properly recognized as reviewed instead of raw rt tags.
Added Kanji - Image Deck (did 1757158925901) to reviewed vocabulary set so single-kanji words (私, 駅) are recognized as known.
Attached sentences from bunpro_grammar_sentences.json to grammar queue objects so sentences are accessible in frontend preview and batch ingestion.
Updated renderGrammarPreview in static/js/modules/study.js to render Bunpro example sentences directly on grammar cards.

evidence.bulk_coverage_query: Replaced per-rule loop in grammar_vocab_gate.py with a single bulk query on bunpro_grammar_vocab_coverage, reducing runtime from 3s to 0.43s.

evidence.problem_resolved: Prove section had zero feedback on button clicks, invisible option selection, inverted submit flow, missing progress counter, and orphaned Keigo Oral Interview leaf.
implementation_details: Updated tab_exams.html into a clean 3-branch architecture (1. Scritto: Drill Lab, 2. Orale: Colloquio Keigo, 3. Diagnostica & Pacing).
Built tactile option selection (selectExamOption) with immediate solid dark active state, checkmark, and card status badge '✓ Risposto (A)'.
Implemented live progress counter (drillAnswerProgress) tracking answered / total questions and completion percentage.
Added prominent in-leaf bottom submit bar with missing question confirmation guard to prevent accidental omissions.
Integrated orphaned Keigo Oral Interview simulator into Leaf 2 with TTS audio playback and disclosure drawers for model answers.
Modularized exams.js and exam_analytics.js to strictly adhere to the <= 200 lines invariant.
Bumped index.html asset version to v=20260912_18 for instant cache-busting.

evidence.problem_resolved: Text and complex Japanese kanji strokes were too small and strained to read on desktop/computer screens (10px-12px badges, 16px questions, 12-14px options).
implementation_details: Added responsive root font-size scaling in editorial.css (17px on >=1024px desktop, 18px on >=1440px wide desktop) scaling all rem-based typography cleanly.
Scaled Japanese question text from text-base to text-base md:text-xl with generous leading and tracking in exams.js and interview.js.
Scaled exam option card text from text-xs sm:text-sm to text-sm md:text-base, option indicators to w-6 h-6 md:w-7 md:h-7, and padding to p-3 md:p-3.5.
Replaced hardcoded text-[10px] and text-[11px] with responsive text-xs md:text-sm across tab_exams.html, exams.js, exam_analytics.js, and interview.js.
Enlarged results score header to text-xl md:text-2xl and distractor analysis text to text-xs md:text-sm leading-relaxed.
Bumped cache-busting assets to editorial.css?v=20260912_19 and main.js?v=20260912_19.
Verified strictly <= 200 lines per file across all codebases.

implementation_details: Created academic/exam_notes.py managing persistent JSON storage of user reasoning in /opt/japan/exams/user_notes.json.
Added POST and GET /api/exams/notes endpoints in api/routes/exam_routes.py and enriched GET /api/exams/questions with saved_comment and saved_answer.
Updated ExamSubmitRequest to accept comments dictionary and persist notes in both session details and user_notes.json.
Created static/js/modules/exam_notes.js with debounced auto-save (600ms), visual status indicator ('💾 Salvato per revisione'), and dual localStorage fallback.
Added note textarea on each exam question card in exams.js and restored user answers from persistent storage on load.
Rendered user comments in the distractor analysis results box in exam_analytics.js.
